method: Read XLSX ZIP parts via streaming XML, resolve shared/inline strings, count all stored worksheet cells and formula/cache/error nodes, independently inspect headers via openpyxl; parse HTML-XLS cell text and complete annual CSV. Dimensions come from actual cell coordinates, not metadata. No original file writes. Published report omits per-investor transaction samples.

classification.nse_matrices: One price value per date and symbol. No separate open/high/low/close/volume fields, no EPS or P/E. Compatible with close-price analysis only after source price basis/corporate-action/identity verification; do not synthesize OHLCV.
classification.fpi_transactions: Masked investor transaction reports with ISIN, trade/report dates, rate, quantity and value. Not OHLCV candles, holdings percentages or company EPS.
classification.fii_dii: Historical aggregate gross purchase/sales and net flow, not per-company fundamental data.
classification.html_xls: Monthly FPI net investments by category in INR crores; not DII and not stock-level flow.

important_findings: All 14 root XLSX contain values only, no formula nodes.
The ten NSE XLSX and annual CSV have identical 1,417-symbol headers; header presence is not nonmissing coverage or verified historical identity.
January 2022 transaction workbook declares A1 but actual range A1:S192104; dimension-trusting imports can silently truncate.
fii_dii.xlsx has no dimension metadata; actual range A1:G2969. There are 628 same-date duplicate rows and all are identical across six numerical fields; no conflicting same-date rows detected.
Binary fii_stats_08-Jun-2026.xls and fii_stats_08-Jun-2026.1.xls have identical SHA256; preserve originals pending approved cleanup.

limitations: No historical price basis, corporate-action adjustment, market-calendar completeness, symbol lifecycle, publication date or upstream authority independently established.
Values-only files have no formulas to preserve or recalculate within these 14 workbooks; this does not cover formulas elsewhere in the repository or archives.
No root file named NSE.XLSX exists in this preserved release set.
No live market, Mongo or production app comparison performed.
Three binary XLS file contents remain unread because bundled xlrd is absent; no software installation attempted.
Other ten root CSV and nested archives are outside this subtask; main agent is separately inspecting AM.07.Parameter.Files.zip.
This is an exploratory read-only audit, not a reusable untrusted-workbook import validator.
